summary.text: Ryan Spaude is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 89 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
He is a prosecutor who worked in the Brown County District Attorney's Office.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Spaude earned a bachelor's degree from Princeton in 2016 and a law degree from the University of Wisconsin Law School.
His career experience includes working as a prosecutor in the Brown County District Attorney's Office.
Spaude took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Republican Elijah Behnke in District 89, and serves on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety and Tourism committees.
